_note: Episode 2 keyframes. Shot rules: close-ups, one plate per location, characters on white then composited (pipeline/make_keys.py). plates/siege.png is from Figma; the rest are NVIDIA FLUX.2 klein drafts to be upgraded with Figma when credits reset.
style: Style: modern Japanese TV anime key frame, crisp clean ink line art, cel shading with two-tone hard shadows, vivid saturated colour, expressive face.
white: Anime character illustration, medium shot from the waist up, the whole head and both shoulders visible with space above the head, character centered, on a plain flat solid bright green chroma-key background with nothing else:

plates.street: a Manila street outside the old stone walls of Intramuros in the afternoon, a parked motorcycle with a square insulated delivery box on the back, acacia trees, a stone gate in the distance, warm afternoon sunlight.
plates.baluarte: the ruins of an old Spanish colonial stone bastion in Intramuros Manila today, thick weathered grey-brown volcanic stone walls and circular stone ruins, green lawn and tropical garden, a small blank stone plaque on a pedestal, golden late-afternoon light, long shadows.
plates.siege: the old Spanish colonial stone bastion wall of Manila in 1762 under bombardment, a ragged breach in the wall, rubble, gunpowder smoke, orange smoky sky.
plates.hall: the interior of a dim Spanish colonial stone hall in 1762 at night, thick stone arches, heavy wooden table with candles, tall shuttered windows glowing orange from fires outside, smoke haze.
plates.bacolor: a Philippine provincial town in Pampanga in 1762 at sunrise, nipa and bamboo houses on stilts, coconut palms, green rice fields, a dirt road, distant blue mountain, hopeful golden morning light.

chars.officer: an eighteenth-century British army officer, about forty-five, white powdered wig, black tricorne hat with gold trim, red coat with gold braid, frowning in frustration, jaw clenched.

chars.woman: a mysterious young Filipina woman, long black hair, wearing a long dark coat, holding a red umbrella over her shoulder, a round bronze medallion at her neck, a faint knowing smile, looking sideways at the viewer, sunset rim light.

full.intro: a young Filipino man, about twenty, lean, warm brown skin, tousled black hair tied in a small topknot, red cloth headband with long tails, wearing a loose off-white cotton collarless baro shirt with rolled sleeves, a round bronze medallion on a cord around his neck, one indigo geometric tattoo on his right forearm, smiling confidently at the viewer with arms crossed, and beside him a medium-sized black Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck, behind them a swirling golden time portal of clock gears and light. Half-body shot, golden rim light.
full.medallion: extreme close-up of a brown hand holding an old round bronze medallion engraved with a sun and a triangle on a worn cord, the medallion glowing bright gold with sparks and light rays, dark background.
full.ships: a fleet of eighteenth-century wooden sailing warships with tall masts and white sails anchored in a tropical bay, cannons firing with flashes and white smoke, a walled stone city on the distant shore, dramatic orange sky. No people.
full.wallfall: a huge section of an old stone fortress wall exploding and collapsing from a cannon hit, flying stone blocks, fire flash, dust cloud and smoke, dramatic low angle, orange sky. No people.
full.city: a walled Spanish colonial stone city by a tropical bay at dusk in 1762, columns of black smoke rising from inside the walls, church towers in silhouette, red sunset, sailing warships in the bay. No people.
full.coins: extreme close-up of an open wooden treasure chest overflowing with silver Spanish coins on a wooden table, candle light, a white-gloved hand in a red sleeve reaching toward it.
full.quill: extreme close-up of an elegant hand in a lace cuff signing a parchment with a white feather quill on a polished table, candlelight, wax seal and ribbon, the writing only illegible scribbles, luxurious eighteenth-century European room blurred behind.
full.leave: eighteenth-century wooden sailing warships sailing away toward the horizon of a tropical bay at sunrise, seen from behind old stone walls, calm golden sea, birds. No people.
full.tattoo: extreme close-up of a young man's brown forearm in a teal jacket sleeve pushed up, showing two small indigo geometric tribal tattoos side by side, the newer one faintly glowing gold, sunset light.
full.phone: extreme close-up of a brown hand holding a smartphone, the screen showing a big green check mark and a gold coin icon and nothing else, glowing in dusk light, old stone wall blurred behind.
